acceptance: A machine-origin overlap is judged by a fake judge, and the decision is applied with the reasoning recorded in overlap_review
A human-origin overlap exits 3 and writes .evolve/inbox/pending-intake/<id>.json with the justification and the options
evolve inbox resolve applies each option: supersedes, merge-into, relates, distinct and withdraw
When no overlap is above the threshold, no judge call occurs
Each add prints where the item lands in the rank and the top movers
fix: Add a validated origin field (operator, console, cycle or retro); autofilers set it, and evolve inbox add --origin defaults to console. Add a deterministic overlap pre-check: a Jaccard score of shared files and dirs, connects_to, and title-token similarity. Above a policy threshold, call the new deep-tier inbox-overlap-judge profile through the bridge, with a JSON contract (verdict, rationale, related ids, confidence). For machine origin, apply the verdict through the lifecycle writer and store the reasoning in overlap_review. For human origin, exit 3 and write .evolve/inbox/pending-intake/<id>.json; add evolve inbox resolve <id> with --supersedes, --merge-into, --relates, --distinct and --withdraw. Each add prints where the item lands and the top movers. Use a fake judge in every test.
